rule.eligibility: validation energy ratio (view and shadow separately, scene mean, in dB) within +-3 dB at every budget
rule.score: mean over the four budgets of (ln error_view + ln error_shadow) / 2 on validation; lowest eligible wins
rule.fallback: if no candidate is eligible, the lowest score wins and the violation is reported
rule.defaultOn: on test at 1/256 (live budget): error_view and error_shadow both below raw, energy ratio within +-3 dB in view and shadow, and the rigid-vs-FDTD shadow error not above raw; otherwise the setting ships opt-in

description.ls: least-squares real gain per family and budget (denoiser report baseline, direct fixed at 1)
description.ls-shadow: least squares with shadow receivers given half of every scene's weight
description.energy: per family and budget, the gain that preserves the family's expected energy
description.rho-wiener: g = 1 / (1 + k_f rho), rho = routes per sample of that family at run time; one k per family
description.rho-energy: g = (1 + k_f rho)^(-1/2): the level-preserving form of rho-wiener with the same k
